title: Pune Venue A Capacity
text: Venue A in Pune supports up to 40 attendees in the main workshop room. A classroom layout is recommended for training events.

title: Venue A Cancellation
text: Venue A cancellation requests made more than 72 hours before the event are eligible for a full venue-fee refund. Later cancellations are subject to the stated exception policy.

title: Venue A Catering
text: Venue A offers on-site vegetarian and non-vegetarian catering. External catering is allowed only with prior approval from the venue coordinator.

title: Venue B Capacity
text: Venue B in Pune supports up to 60 attendees and has a flexible seating plan for workshops.

title: Venue B Cancellation
text: Venue B cancellation terms require requests at least 48 hours before the event for the standard refund policy to apply.

title: Venue B Catering
text: Venue B provides buffet catering and packaged refreshments. Catering must be confirmed with the booking team before the event.

title: Travel Reimbursement Standard
text: Standard domestic travel reimbursement covers eligible transportation and lodging costs when documented with receipts and submitted under the employee travel policy.

title: International Travel Exception
text: International travel introduces a mandatory foreign-currency receipt verification requirement. The employee must submit the foreign-currency documentation with the reimbursement request.

title: Late Booking Exception
text: A booking made after travel requires senior director approval before the reimbursement exception can be applied.

title: Travel Submission Window
text: Travel reimbursement requests should be submitted within 30 days of the completed trip unless a documented exception is approved.

title: Workshop External Catering
text: External catering for a workshop is permitted when venue approval is recorded in the event request. The approval should name the catering provider.

title: Workshop Refund Exceptions
text: A documented exceptional cancellation case may receive a partial refund after review. The final amount is determined from the event agreement.

title: Workshop Availability
text: Venue availability depends on the event calendar. A date is considered confirmed only after the booking team issues a confirmation record.

title: Workshop Room Setup
text: For a workshop of 30 attendees, classroom or U-shaped layouts are supported. Capacity checks should include equipment and facilitator space.

title: Catering Dietary Requests
text: Dietary requests should be provided before final catering confirmation so the venue can verify menu availability and preparation constraints.
